(iv) The `CodeQL` failure is NOT a workflow job: check-run 106862973938 is a GitHub Advanced Security code-scanning gate (app slug `github-advanced-security`, app id 57789, check suite 96831076767, no workflow run behind it), which is why `gh run view --job 106862973938` returns 404. The repository's own `CodeQL (JavaScript/TypeScript)` job in security-scans.yml uses the same `security-extended` suite and PASSED - that job asserts the analysis uploaded, the platform check asserts no new alerts. Nothing was dismissed; routed to `integrations` as HF-RELEASE-SEC-CODEQL. (ii) The `Lint And Build` failure is a genuine tsc result, not pipeline instability: step 11 `Typecheck` ran 17:38:34Z->18:46:52Z (68m18s) of a 70m40s job and emitted 1,384 primary diagnostics across 407 files. The 1h10m40s is real single-pass tsc work, matching the known slow-typecheck profile already recorded in RELEASE-006; no timeout or memory change was made because any value chosen from a FAILING run's timings would be a guess.
